name: atlias
description: A harness for AI coding agents, built so that done means done: a sub-harness inside Codex, Claude Code and sixteen more, or an agent of its own in any terminal.

interface.shortDescription: Done means done: checks every claim of done against what really happened
interface.longDescription: atlias checks an agent's claim that it finished against the session itself: a pass claimed with no test run, a pass after a failing run, done with no check since the last edit, placeholders, weakened tests, new code nothing calls, files that do not parse, loops, and destructive commands. It adds a memory shared with every other harness and a knowledge graph that answers codebase questions before files are read. The hooks and the MCP server come from atlias install --codex, which points Codex at a launcher that survives updates.
